func decodeGTPv1u(data []byte, p gopacket.PacketBuilder) error {
	gtp := &GTPv1U{}
	err := gtp.DecodeFromBytes(data, p)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	p.AddLayer(gtp)
	return p.NextDecoder(gtp.NextLayerType())
}
